entries.title: Psalms 66:1
segments:
In this psalm the writer takes occasion, from a personal deliverance vouchsafed to him by God--or, as some think, a deliverance granted to God's people, in whose name he speaks--to celebrate the wonderful dealings of God with his covenant people in all past ages. 
 
The friends of God are desirous that all in every land may know, acknowledge, praise, and adore him.

entries.title: Psalms 66:3
segments: Submit themselves unto thee; be forced to profess subjection and obedience to thee.

entries.title: Psalms 66:6
segments: He turned the sea into dry land; at the time the children of Israel crossed the Red sea.

entries.title: Psalms 66:9
segments: The preservation of our bodies and souls is the work of God, and the fruit of his kindness; they should therefore be devoted to his service.

entries.title: Psalms 66:12
segments:
Through fire and through water; fiery trials and floods of temptation. 
 
  Into a wealthy place; into circumstances of propserity.

entries.title: Psalms 66:13
segments: Deliverance from special troubles calls for special thanksgiving to God, and the promises which we made in affliction should be conscientiously fulfilled.

entries.title: Psalms 66:17
segments: Jehovah is a God who hears prayer, and supplications offered to him in spirit and in truth will be abundantly answered.

entries.title: Psalms 66:18
segments: Iniquity in my heart; such as he was charged with, or any known sin.
